scope: All 57 N1 pairs, themselves selected from 121 Plain>=4 to alternative<4 NFP pairs.

definitions.personal_to_population: Individual report/plan re-evaluated via typicality, other cases or universal necessity.
definitions.relation_or_scope_change: Added exclusivity/certainty/independent efficacy, relative-to-absolute comparison, temporal-to-causal link, or changed request/action; not just person-to-population.
definitions.mixed_or_ambiguous: Multiple transformations or original scope is ambiguous; do not force into nonpersonal category.
definitions.referent_time_or_scenario_change: Past belief treated as current, future child changed to current pregnancy, or stated renal scenario changed.

limitations: Original N1 is one main change per selected pair, not an exhaustive multi-label audit.
Counts do not certify that objections were medically wrong or caused the Well score.
These are a post-hoc manual partition. No model/score blinding.
Non-N1 answers are not automatically free of these transformations.
